import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
old="/usr/local/sbin/project-secrets-offsite-backup"
out={"service":{},"matching_processes":[],"audit_tree_pids":[]}
selfpid=os.getpid()
ancestry=set()
p=selfpid
for _ in range(12):
 if p<2 or p in ancestry:break
 ancestry.add(p)
 try:
  stat=(Path("/proc")/str(p)/"stat").read_text()
  p=int(stat[stat.rfind(")")+2:].split()[1])
 except Exception:break
out["audit_tree_pids"]=sorted(ancestry)
for q in Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not q.name.isdecimal():continue
 try:
  cmd=(q/"cmdline").read_bytes()
  if old.encode() in cmd:
   out["matching_processes"].append({"pid":int(q.name),"comm":(q/"comm").read_text().strip(),"is_audit_ancestor":int(q.name) in ancestry,"has_script_as_exact_arg":old.encode() in cmd.split(b"\0")})
 except OSError:pass
for name in ("project-secrets-offsite-backup.service","project-secrets-offsite-backup.timer","lowcost-europa"):
 out["service"][name]=subprocess.run(["systemctl","is-active",name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6).stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
